content.title: Everything That’s In Store For You In 2020 - Aries, Tauras, Gemini, Cancer.
content.text: Everything That’s In Store For You In 2020 - Aries, Tauras, Gemini, Cancer. The year 2020 has already begun to unfold its adventures and lessons. Get ready to put your best foot and face forward with our tips and tricks, and slay your way to success. Aries (21 March - 20 April) - 2020 is going to be career-defining for you. You could be getting that job you’ve always wanted or a big promotion, and some might even start laying foundations to their own businesses. The key for you is to add the colour red to your wardrobe. Red signifies your ruling planet - Mars and is undeniably the best way to bring out your fiery character. We’d suggest these acetate round frames that’ll prove to be a powerful accessory. Taurus (21 April - 21 May) - You are in for a major transformation this year as 2020 is going to be an eventful year, far away from your comfort zone. It might seem a little daunting at first, but you’re going to love it. As you enter an experimental phase in your life, we’d say you opt for these clear eyeglasses that’ll blend in with your simplistic personality and make you feel at home. Gemini (22 May - 21 June) - This new year is all about communication. A key lesson for you is not to take anything or anyone for granted. Knowledge is power, so really ’see’ the person you’re with or want to be with. Your style and attitude are ripe for an overhaul this year. Vibrant colours would match your vibrant persona, just like these tortoise-shell frames. Cancer (22 June - 22 July) - Empowerment - that’s going to be the theme of 2020 for you. You’ll be flowing with innovative ideas, so make sure you take those ideas to your heart and soul and make them a part of you. Given that your ruling planet is moon you’re affinity lies towards the lighter shades like white, off-white and grey . Our suggestion - these gunmetal eyeglasses that’ll also indicate your love for all things retro. Whatever your personality, at John Jacobs, find your favourite styles from over 500 designs and express your individuality. January 16, 2020 January 16, 2020
